content:
Extract the invoice data from the document below into JSON with exactly this schema:

{
  "vendor_name": "string",
  "invoice_number": "string",
  "invoice_date": "YYYY-MM-DD",
  "due_date": "YYYY-MM-DD or null if not applicable",
  "currency": "3-letter ISO code",
  "subtotal": 0.00,
  "tax_amount": 0.00,
  "total": 0.00,
  "line_items": [
    {"description": "string", "quantity": 0, "unit_price": 0.00, "amount": 0.00}
  ]
}

Note: subtotal means all pre-tax charges (including shipping and after discounts).

Return only the JSON object, nothing else.

DOCUMENT:
FAIRVIEW TRDG PTE LTD

TAX INVOICE

Invoice No : FT-8901
Date       : 05/04/2025
Payment    : Net 14

Sold To: Banyan Interiors LLP

--------------------------------------------------------------
 DESCRIPTION                      QTY    UNIT PRICE     AMOUNT
--------------------------------------------------------------
 Bamboo shelving unit              4       85.00        340.00
 Delivery & assembly               1       40.00         40.00
--------------------------------------------------------------
                                        Subtotal:      $380.00
                                        GST (9%):       $34.20
                                        TOTAL:         $414.20

Goods remain property of the seller until paid in full.

```json
{
  "vendor_name": "FAIRVIEW TRDG PTE LTD",
  "invoice_number": "FT-8901",
  "invoice_date": "2025-04-05",
  "due_date": "2025-04-19",
  "currency": "SGD",
  "subtotal": 380.00,
  "tax_amount": 34.20,
  "total": 414.20,
  "line_items": [
    {
      "description": "Bamboo shelving unit",
      "quantity": 4,
      "unit_price": 85.00,
      "amount": 340.00
    },
    {
      "description": "Delivery & assembly",
      "quantity": 1,
      "unit_price": 40.00,
      "amount": 40.00
    }
  ]
}
```
